newsitem.title: ROMANIA: VOLUMES, AVERAGE PRICES LOWER ON BUCHAREST BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: VOLUMES, AVERAGE PRICES LOWER ON BUCHAREST BOURSE.

text.p: Most Bucharest bourse stocks lost on their average prices on Thursday with investors mired in a wait-and-see mood, pushing volumes and turnover low.
Two independent indices, the VAB and the BIG, slipped by 3.2 percent each from the previous session. The BIG first-tier index fell by 3.9 percent to 3,039.36 points.
"Trading was a lot quieter today, with buyers definitely waiting for prices to move lower," said a trader.
Volumes thinned to 1.9 million shares from 2.8 million on Wednesday and turnover fell by 3.6 billion lei to 6.3 billion.
Traders said they expected investors to keep the waiting mood on Friday and saw a rebound of the market next week.

The first tier was in the front line of the session's trading with 5.2 billion lei in turover, or 82 percent of overall turnover. But two high-caps lost on their average prices, one remained unchanged and only one managed to inch up.
All four blue chips closed weaker.
Antibiotice pharmaceuticals company and fertiliser maker Azomures had lower average prices and they also closed 150 and respectively 400 lei weaker at 4,900 and 2,650.
The average price of Oltchim chemical plant marked time, but its closing quote was down 250 lei at 2,350.
Pharmaceuticals company Terapia was the only one to gain on both its average quote and closing price. It ended 50 lei stronger at 6,250.
Policolor dye maker provided the only excitement in dull second-tier trading. It had 809 million lei in turnover and closed 200 lei firmer at 5,500.
Twelve second-tier stocks had no trade and two were suspended.
Newcomer Stratusmob furniture maker traded some 4,500 shares and closed at 1,500 lei, 500 lei higher than its opening price.
